targeting_data.copy:
Why was this ad presented?
In order to provide the most relevant offers to you during your purchase on this website, we partner with Rokt to connect you with select advertisers. The following parameters may be used to do so: transactional information entered upon purchase (i.e. name, zip code, order value, etc.), a secure unique identifier (i.e. hashed email address), cookies or tracking technology, and your interactions with previous offers of this type.
You are always in control of how your information is used on this website. You may turn off cookies via your browser settings, or exercise your data subject rights (including restriction, deletion and general opt outs) by visiting Rokt's privacy policy at https://www.rokt.com/privacy-policy/.
